Record notes

Reusable activity and method catalog, scoped retrieval and chooser runtime. Source notes and private data stay externally bound.

Version 0.1.2 includes 1 complete skill procedures. Complete runtime and synthetic example; private activity corpus excluded.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared MCP dependencies; Your own authorized activity catalog.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add activities-templates@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.
